title: Thorildsby Modpack
description: The official modpack used on the Thorildsby project.
body:
This modpack is used for the Thorildsby project.
It is based heavily on Create and mainly constructed for creative-mode.</br>
**THIS IS THE OFFICIAL MODPACK REQUIRED TO PLAY ON THE THORILDSBY SERVER**</br>
https://thorildsby.com
## Features
### Building blocks
As this modpack was designed for a building server, many new building blocks have been added, these allow us to bring our buildings to the next level. This also includes [Copycats+](https://modrinth.com/mod/copycats), which allows for new, otherwise unthinkable, building options.
### Trains
Another big focus of this modpack is trains. All cities of the project are connected via a network of railway vehicles. To fully realise realistic, good-looking and speedy trains, we are using [the Create mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) in combination with the [Steam 'n' Rails addon](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails)
### Foods
The last big factor of this modpack is the foods it adds. With [Farmer's Delight]([https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight)) we get plenty of new foods and cooking methods. In addition, we are using the small [Roasted Onions]([https://modrinth.com/mod/roastedonions](https://modrinth.com/mod/roastedonions)) mod, made by members of the Thorildsby project, to add foods of our liking to the game.
### And a lot more!
Listing every single feature of this modpack would be a bit too much for me to write. There are still a lot of small but nice features in this mod, but the main features are already covered above.

## Knwown bugs
**Please note that the Thorildsby Discord server or project members will usually not help you with bugs, unless if they actively prevent you from playing on the Thorildsby project**</br>
- Some items seem to get removed from the creative menu and/or the [JEI]([https://modrinth.com/mod/jei](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)) menu.</br> Fix: unknown
- The options menu is not usable</br> Fix: Disable [Essential]([https://modrinth.com/mod/essential](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential)). Unlike the name implies, this mod is not required for play.
- The game crashes without the logs giving any information on why.</br> Fix: Update the drivers of your graphics card.

## Disclaimer
This modpack was made for the sole purpose of creative mode. We can't guarantee functionality or playability for survival mode.</br>
This modpack includes a mod which is not available on Modrinth, click [here](https://github.com/CatStorm1208/TotemImmunity) for its Source Code.
